company.description:
GitStart develops an online freelancer hiring platform to help businesses pass on their backlog work.

GitStart automatically manages hundreds of remote developers and partners with their client’s engineering teams, accelerating their software development. GitStart is the secret sauce for companies to ramp up their software development capacity, on-demand.

GitStart's mission is to build a strong tech community by bringing the most talented software developers into their platform and grow their clients’ businesses while acting as a career springboard for their community members.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,438,941 to $91,767,037, a 26.68x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (+6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
